title: 오늘 하루
topic: how the learner's day has been
opening: Hi there! How has your day been so far?
openingKo: 안녕하세요! 오늘 하루 어떻게 보내고 있어요?

title: 취미
opening: What do you like to do in your free time?
openingKo: 시간 날 때 뭐 하는 걸 좋아해요?

title: 여행
opening: Have you been anywhere fun recently, or is there a place you really want to visit?
openingKo: 최근에 재미있는 곳에 다녀왔어요? 아니면 꼭 가 보고 싶은 곳이 있어요?

title: 음식
opening: What's your favorite food? I'm always looking for something new to try.
openingKo: 제일 좋아하는 음식이 뭐예요? 저는 늘 새로 먹어 볼 걸 찾고 있거든요.

title: 영화와 드라마
opening: Have you watched any good movies or shows lately?
openingKo: 요즘 재미있게 본 영화나 드라마 있어요?

title: 일과 공부
opening: What do you do? Are you working or studying these days?
openingKo: 무슨 일 하세요? 요즘 일하세요, 아니면 공부하세요?

title: 주말 계획
opening: Do you have any plans for this weekend?

title: 목표와 꿈
opening: What's one goal you're working on this year?
openingKo: 올해 이루려고 노력 중인 목표 하나만 말해 줄래요?

title: 고향
topic: the learner's hometown and where they live now
opening: Where are you from? What's your hometown like?

title: 최근 산 물건
opening: What's the last thing you bought that made you really happy?
openingKo: 최근에 사고 정말 기분 좋았던 물건이 뭐예요?
